mito -use json,collections src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
"{\"n\": 999999999999999999999}".decode_json_string_numbers().as(o,
	{
		"as_cel_value": o,
		"n_is_string": type(o.n) == string,
		"encoded_json_text": o.encode_json(),
		"round_trip_text_equal": o.encode_json() == "{\"n\":999999999999999999999}",
		"rebuilt_map_encoded": {"n": o.n}.encode_json(),
	}
)
-- want.txt --
{
	"as_cel_value": {
		"n": "999999999999999999999"
	},
	"encoded_json_text": "{\"n\":999999999999999999999}",
	"n_is_string": true,
	"rebuilt_map_encoded": "{\"n\":\"999999999999999999999\"}",
	"round_trip_text_equal": true
}
